findings.title: Table 2 NNTXMAX CI excludes 0.5 but p=0.9017
findings.description: NNTXMAX reports MW=0.8000 with 95% CI 0.5362 to 1.0000 at n=10/3, which excludes the Mann-Whitney null of 0.5, but the printed p=0.9017 is non-significant. check_estimate_ci recovered p=0.0112 from the CI and flagged that the interval excludes the null while the p does not. The upper bound is censored at 1, but the lower bound 0.5362 already lies above 0.5, so the discordance does not depend on the Wald midpoint. If the CI is right the row is significant; if the p is right the CI is wrong.

findings.title: Table 2 NNTXDIAM and NNTXAREA share MW and CI, not p
findings.description: NNTXDIAM and NNTXAREA both print MW=0.4000 and 95% CI (0.0704 to 0.7296) at n=10/3, but p=0.4146 versus p=0.4936. check_estimate_ci recovered the same Wald p=0.5521 from both intervals. The same Mann-Whitney estimate, interval and sample size cannot yield two different p-values. One of the two p-values is misaligned with the printed MW and CI.

adjudication.rationale: NNTXDIAM and NNTXAREA share MW=0.4000 and CI (0.0704 to 0.7296) at n=10/3, which can occur if area is monotone in diameter, but they print p=0.4146 versus p=0.4936. Those p-values cannot both belong to the same MW, CI and n. check_estimate_ci recovered Wald p=0.5521 from the shared interval.

findings.title: All eight Table 2 Mann-Whitney p-values miss the U lattice
findings.description: Each Table 2 component p at n1=10, n2=3 falls between achievable Mann-Whitney p-values (grimu_check and grimu_coexistence: 8 of 8 flagged, no co-existence pair). Nearest U for p=0.9017 is U near 14 (null is 15), while MW=0.8000 implies U=24. Rule 12 caps a granularity miss at suspicious; a different variance estimator in Wei-Lachin software could shift p off the untied lattice. The cluster of eight misses, including p-values that do not match their own MW, is the finding.

adjudication.rationale: The paper attributes these p-values to the Wei-Lachin procedure, a large-sample multivariate generalization of Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney, not to an exact univariate U. A Wald or other Wei-Lachin variance estimator will miss the untied lattice, so GRIM-U does not license a U-lattice accusation. Component p-versus-CI discordances are kept separately.

findings.title: Combined Wei-Lachin CI is far narrower than every component
findings.description: Table 2 prints eight component 95% CIs at n=10/3 with widths of about 0.66 (NNTXDIAM 0.0704 to 0.7296). The Combined (Wei-Lachin) interval at the same n is 0.5456 to 0.5766, width 0.031, and is the sole significant result (p<0.0001). All eight components are non-significant and mixed in direction (MW 0.4000 to 0.8000). Independent averaging of eight endpoints would shrink a Wald interval only about 2.8-fold, not 21-fold. check_estimate_ci finds the Combined CI and p internally consistent with each other, so the defect is that this Combined row cannot come from the printed components at n=10/3.

anchors.quote: The combined result of the histological assessments shows significant superiority of the 'stimulus yes' group of animals versus the 'stimulus no' group (MW=0.5611, 95%CI 0.5456-0.5766, Wei-Lachin procedure, directional test, exploratory interpretation.

adjudication.rationale: The Combined interval (0.5456 to 0.5766, width 0.031) is about 21-fold narrower than the component intervals at n=10/3 (NNTXDIAM width 0.659). Eight independent endpoints would shrink a Wald interval only ~2.8-fold, and the eight MW values are mixed around 0.5. This row is the paper's only p<0.0001 result and the stated statistical proof of histometric superiority; the printed components cannot produce it.
adjudication.title_was: Combined Wei-Lachin CI is far narrower than every component
adjudication.description_was: Table 2 prints eight component 95% CIs at n=10/3 with widths of about 0.66 (for example NNTXDIAM 0.0704 to 0.7296). The Combined (Wei-Lachin) interval at the same n is 0.5456 to 0.5766, width 0.031, and is the sole significant result (p<0.0001). All eight components are non-significant. A Wei-Lachin average of those endpoints cannot shrink the interval twenty-fold at n=10/3, especially with mixed MW direction (0.4000 versus 0.8000). check_estimate_ci recovered SE=0.0079 for the combined row versus SE=0.168 for NNTXDIAM.

adjudication.summary: The paper's only statistically significant result, the Table 2 Combined Wei-Lachin Mann-Whitney of 0.5611 (95% CI 0.5456 to 0.5766, n=10/3, p<0.0001), cannot be produced from the eight component intervals printed above it, which are about twenty-fold wider and mixed in direction. That same Combined row, including the 10/3 denominator, is reprinted as Table 3's combined muscle result beside rows whose n are 16/5 and 11/2, and Table 3's p-values 0.4146 and 0.4936 match Table 2's first two rows. Table 2 also pairs one MW and CI with two different p-values and reports NNTXMAX CI 0.5362-1.0000 against p=0.9017. Count-percent, ratio, bounds, summation and the Results attrition cascade 30 to 21 to 15 reconcile. A corrigendum should withdraw or recompute the Wei-Lachin combined tests, align Table 3, and correct the CMAP-positive counts (8 of 21 versus 8 of 16 versus 7 of 14) and the Figure 9 angiogenesis mean 2.57 versus Table 4. This review did not establish intent, did not re-analyse raw histometric files, and did not treat GRIM-U lattice misses as accusations because the paper attributes p-values to Wei-Lachin rather than exact univariate U.

rounding_convention.note: Values that fail the round-half convention but are consistent if the reporter TRUNCATES (SPSS's default, and several journal styles). NOT a finding and never counted as one: a single instance is a house style. The RATE is the signal -- this class of anomaly is commoner in papers with more serious problems, so a high proportion is grounds to look harder, not evidence in itself.

grace.reading: Nothing needed an allowance; every item reconciled on its printed values.

sd_convention.note: Values that fail under the sample (Bessel, n-1) SD but are consistent under the POPULATION (n) SD -- numpy's std default and Excel's STDEVP. NOT a finding and never counted as one: choosing a convention is not fabrication. The RATE is the signal, on the same reasoning as the rounding convention above.

harness_sweep.why: These checks were aimed by the harness, not by the model: every eligible target in the paper's tables was enumerated and checked. That makes their coverage identical from run to run, which the model-aimed checks are not -- two runs of this pipeline on one paper overlapped on 0 of 10 model-aimed targets.
